Set B only looks mixed because half of its pictures are not birds at all (a fridge, a laptop, a truck…), and its birds are nearly identical. Pictures that do not show the prompt do not count. Set A shows many different birds.
Set A shows different dogs and scenes across its five clips. Set B plays the same clip five times. Compare the clips with each other, not the motion inside one clip.
